releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.0:
• 📷 Scan handwritten task lists from photos using AI — instantly populates your day card
• 🔒 Smart scan protection: daily card modal locks while your photo is being processed so no credits go to waste
• 🤖 AI-powered daily recap summaries now processed directly from our AI service for faster generation
• 🏆 Leaderboard visibility controls — choose whether to appear on the public leaderboard
• 🐛 Various bug fixes, performance improvements, and UI polish
